eyebrow.zh: 把 Agent 时代的 git 历史，折叠成可评审的任务变更集。
eyebrow.en: Fold agent-era git history into reviewable task changesets.

headline.zh:
评审一个 Agent 任务，
而不是几十个微型提交。
headline.en:
Review one agent task,
not dozens of micro-commits.

sub.zh: Histfold 关联会话日志、触碰路径与 Agent trailer，从已经写好的历史中重建任务单元——严格只读，单一静态二进制，零配置。
sub.en: Histfold correlates session logs, touched paths and agent trailers to rebuild task units from history that is already written — strictly read-only, one static binary, zero configuration.

caption.zh: 首屏为示意性的粒子场景；实际运行输出见下方实录。
caption.en: An illustrative particle scene; the recorded run appears below.

body.zh: 关联三种相互独立的信号——会话日志、触碰路径、Agent trailer——从已经写好的历史中重建任务单元。不需要 hook，也不改写提交。
body.en: Correlates three independent signals — session logs, touched paths and agent trailers — to rebuild task units from history that is already written. No hooks, no history rewriting.

body.zh: 提交本身绝不被改动，变更集只是覆盖在提交之上的一层视图。写入的只有 histfold.html 和打到 stdout 的内容。
body.en: Commits are never touched; a changeset is just a lens over them. The only writes are histfold.html and whatever is printed to stdout.

body.zh: Go 标准库实现，调用系统 git，没有服务进程。产出自包含的 histfold.html 时间线，离线打开，零外部请求。
body.en: Built on the Go standard library and the system git binary, with no servers or daemons. It writes a self-contained histfold.html timeline that opens offline with zero external requests.

title.zh: git 历史，不再是可评审的记录
title.en: Git history is no longer a reviewable record

body.zh: 过去人类用一个深思熟虑的提交交付一项任务；现在同一个任务会以几十个微型提交的形式到达，其间穿插着人工修改，并且没有机器可读的任务归因。翻 git log 重建不出任何东西，squash 又会改写你正想评审的那份记录。Histfold 做的是回溯式折叠：提交不动，变更集是任务级的视图。
body.en: A task a human would once have shipped as one deliberate commit now arrives as dozens of micro-commits, interleaved with human edits and carrying no machine-readable task attribution. Scrolling git log reconstructs nothing, and squashing rewrites the very record you are trying to review. Histfold folds retroactively: commits stay untouched, and changesets are the task-level view.

body.zh: histfold fold 读取 git log 与本地会话日志，把每个提交与归因证据匹配：落在会话活动窗口内且路径重叠记 90% 置信度，仅落在窗口内记 70%，只有 trailer 记 50%，纯时间间隔聚类记 20%。每个变更集携带意图、Agent 与模型、文件数和评审状态。
body.en: histfold fold reads git log and local session logs, then matches every commit against attribution evidence: inside a session's activity window with overlapping paths scores 90% confidence, window-only scores 70%, trailers-only 50%, and pure time-gap clustering 20%. Each changeset carries intent, agent and model, files, and review status.

alt.zh: 折叠流程：提交流与会话日志进入关联阶段，按置信度 90%、70%、50%、20% 归因，输出带意图与评审状态的变更集；人工提交原样穿过，不被强行归因。
alt.en: The fold pipeline: the commit stream and session logs enter correlation, commits are attributed with 90%, 70%, 50% or 20% confidence, and changesets come out with intent and review status; human commits pass through unattributed.

title.zh: 一个二进制，三个内部包

body.zh: ingest 层调用系统 git 并适配 Claude Code 会话日志；fold 引擎是对这些数据的纯关联函数，折叠策略只存在于这一处；render 层打印终端表格，并用内嵌模板写出零外部请求的 HTML 时间线。
body.en: The ingest layer shells out to the system git and adapts Claude Code session logs. The fold engine is a pure correlation function over that data — folding policy lives in exactly one place. The render layer prints a terminal table and writes an HTML timeline from an embedded template with zero external requests.

alt.zh: 架构图：histfold 单一二进制内的 ingest、fold、render 三个内部包，左侧读取 git log 与会话日志，右侧输出终端表格与自包含的 histfold.html。
alt.en: Architecture: the ingest, fold and render packages inside the histfold binary, reading git log and session logs on the left and writing the terminal table plus a self-contained histfold.html on the right.

body.zh: 读取 git log --numstat（经系统 git）与 ~/.claude/projects/<repo-slug>/*.jsonl 会话日志；写出当前目录的 histfold.html，以及 --json 打到 stdout 的内容。评审状态仅从本地引用推导，全程不发起网络请求。
body.en: Reads git log --numstat (via the system git) and ~/.claude/projects/<repo-slug>/*.jsonl session logs; writes histfold.html in the current directory plus whatever --json prints to stdout. Review status is derived from local refs only — no network requests are made.

alt.zh: 接入图：histfold 从 git log、Claude Code 会话日志与提交 trailer 读取证据，写出终端表格、stdout JSON 与 histfold.html；评审状态只看本地引用，无网络请求。
alt.en: Integration map: histfold draws evidence from git log, Claude Code session logs and commit trailers, and writes a terminal table, stdout JSON and histfold.html; review status uses local refs only, with no network requests.

body.zh: 置信度是所用归因证据中较弱一环的强度：90% 会话窗口加路径重叠，70% 会话窗口，50% 仅提交 trailer，20% 纯时间间隔。意图取自匹配会话的第一条用户提示——任务自己的措辞——没有会话时退回到聚类首个提交的标题。
body.en: A changeset's confidence is the strength of the weakest evidence used to attribute it: 90% session window plus path overlap, 70% session window, 50% trailers only, 20% time gaps. Intent is the matched session's first user prompt — the task's own words — falling back to the cluster-head commit subject.

body.zh: 折叠刻意保持单人模式：只关联本机可找到的来源，目前仅适配 Claude Code 的 JSONL 会话日志；其他 Agent 运行时靠 trailer 与时间间隔折叠，置信度更低。跨贡献者折叠需要先解决会话日志共享，它在路线图上，不是承诺。平台支持 macOS 与 Linux。
body.en: Folding is deliberately single-player: it correlates provenance found on the local machine, and only Claude Code JSONL session logs are adapted today; other agent runtimes fold on trailers and time gaps at lower confidence. Cross-contributor folding needs a story for sharing session logs, so it is roadmap, not promise. Platforms are macOS and Linux.

note.zh: 以下命令与输出逐字取自 docs/demo-results.json 的运行记录。输入由 demo/seed.sh 生成的合成演示仓库：212 个交错微型提交、8 份 Claude 会话日志、一段仅 trailer 的 Codex 脉冲与人工跟进提交；种子是确定性的，任何机器上都能原样复现。
note.en: Commands and outputs below are copied verbatim from the recorded run in docs/demo-results.json. The input is a synthetic demo repository generated by demo/seed.sh: 212 interleaved micro-commits, eight Claude session logs, one trailer-only Codex burst and human follow-ups. The seed is deterministic and reproduces exactly on any machine.

body.zh: 在演示仓库中运行 histfold fold：212 个提交折叠为 9 个变更集，同时写出 histfold.html。
body.en: Run histfold fold in the demo repository: 212 commits fold into 9 changesets, and histfold.html is written.

body.zh: 安装需要 Go 1.24+（或从 Releases 下载预编译二进制），PATH 中需要 git 2.30+，支持 macOS 和 Linux。没有会话日志的仓库照样能折叠：Agent trailer 和时间间隔聚类会接手，只是置信度更低。
body.en: Installing needs Go 1.24+ (or grab a prebuilt binary from Releases), git 2.30+ on PATH, macOS or Linux. Repos without session logs still fold: agent trailers and time-gap clustering take over, at lower confidence.

steps.code:
cd your-repo
histfold fold
open histfold.html

git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/histfold
cd histfold
demo/seed.sh
cd histfold-demo
histfold fold

limitations.zh: v0.1 只适配 Claude Code 会话日志；其他 Agent 运行时仅靠 trailer 和时间间隔折叠，置信度更低。
limitations.en: v0.1 adapts Claude Code session logs only; other agent runtimes fold on trailers and time gaps at lower confidence.

limitations.zh: 折叠是单人模式：它关联的是本机上能找到的会话日志；团队仓库的跨贡献者折叠还在路线图上。
limitations.en: Folding is single-player by design: it correlates session logs found on the local machine. Cross-contributor folding for team repos is roadmap.

limitations.zh: v0.1 仅支持 macOS 和 Linux，没有 Windows 构建。
limitations.en: v0.1 is macOS and Linux only; there are no Windows builds.

limitations.zh: 演示仓库是 demo/seed.sh 生成的合成数据；212 → 9 是那次实录运行的结果，不是对你仓库效果的承诺。
limitations.en: The demo repository is synthetic data from demo/seed.sh; 212 commits → 9 changesets is that recorded run's result, not a promise about your repository.
